substantive_checks.recurrence_reduction: PASS: q_(n+1)=(4n+2)q_n+q_(n-1), so the boundary square reduces exactly to q_(n-1)^2 modulo q_n
substantive_checks.continuant_boundary: PASS AFTER REPAIR: n=2 is explicitly the singleton word (7), while the ascending and descending arithmetic-progression displays are asserted literally only for n>=3
substantive_checks.centered_remainder: PASS: oddness of q_n gives a unique centered representative; adjacent coprimality makes it nonzero and proves 1<=rho_n<q_n/2
substantive_checks.degree_one_equivalence: PASS: a monic U+alpha annihilates -q_(n+1)^2 modulo q_n exactly when alpha is in the residue class whose minimum absolute representative has size rho_n
substantive_checks.euclidean_determinant: PASS: b=Aa+c and h=a-A*kappa give r=ah-c*kappa and Ar=bh-ac; varying kappa is equivalent to the displayed congruence class for h
substantive_checks.continued_fraction_scope: PASS: the exact arithmetic-progression word is an all-n description, but ordinary rational separation yields only the unit lower bound
substantive_checks.palindromic_barrier: PASS WITH SCOPE: a palindromic positive word gives a symmetric continuant matrix and numerator square congruent to plus or minus one; this refutes coarse generic-continuant lower bounds but does not apply to the nonpalindromic beta word
substantive_checks.finite_half_pattern: PASS AS EXACT FINITE ONLY: 2*rho_n>=q_(n-1) is replayed for 2<=n<=160 and is not promoted to an all-n theorem
substantive_checks.proper_target_transfer: PASS: centering r_n modulo Q|q_n can only reduce the least residue, so full-target upper bounds transfer and full-target lower bounds do not
substantive_checks.baseline_and_capacity: PASS: the Item282 product baseline is separate; neither an O(n)-height lift nor a superlinear lower bound is proved for a full or large proper target, so booking and capacity reduction are zero

strict_scope.proved: The exact least-residue/degree-one problem, its arithmetic-progression continuant form, and a sharp obstruction to coarse generic-continuant lower bounds.
strict_scope.not_proved: Any all-n upper or growing lower bound for the actual Bessel seed, or any large proper-target least-residue theorem.
strict_scope.next_exact_target: Exploit q_n=|y_n(-2)| and the factorial/hypergeometric seed to decide rho_n beyond generic continuant information.
strict_scope.open: The Item282 product baseline, proper-target arithmetic, every positive beta capacity theorem, Route 1, and every conclusion about e+pi.
